svg.title: Size of Space — Interactive WebGL site

text.tspan: . About: .... A journey through the scale of the universe: 79 objects from asteroid

tspan.tspan: Bennu to the whole observable universe.

text.tspan: . Task: ..... Show the size of cosmic objects across 24 orders of magnitude, so each

tspan.tspan: object is always seen against the one before it.

text.tspan: . Solution: . A Three.js 3D scene with real NASA and USGS maps, ray-traced Saturn

tspan.tspan: rings and procedural GLSL shaders for stars, black holes and galaxies.
Compare mode for any two objects and generative music on the Web Audio

text.tspan: . Result: ... A light static site with one runtime dependency, rendering in real

tspan.tspan: time. RU/EN, a shareable link for every object, trackpad, keyboard and

text.tspan: . Stack: .... TypeScript · Three.js · WebGL · GLSL shaders · Web Audio API · Vite ·
